items.html: Feeding dignity. Sharing love.

At MY Project USA, we believe no one in our community should go hungry. The Community Table is our new effort to provide free hot meals and essential groceries to families and neighbors in need — one meal, one box, one family at a time. Through the power of community, we are bringing people together to nourish bodies, restore dignity, and share love.
items.text: At MY Project USA, we believe no one in our community should go hungry. The Community Table is our new effort to provide free hot meals and essential groceries to families and neighbors in need — one meal, one box, one family at a time. Through the power of community, we are bringing people together to nourish bodies, restore dignity, and share love.

items.html:
Alongside our hot meal program, we are expanding grocery support for families facing food insecurity. This will be in addition to our food distribution at the Mid Ohio Market at MY Project USA.

MY Family Pantry volunteers will be passing additional grocery boxes to those in the highest need, prioritizing families with children and seniors with disabilities. weekly grocery boxes will filled with staple items like rice, flour, lentils, beans, oil, and sugar — enough to feed a family of five for a week.

Distribution will scale up as donations and community contributions increase.

We rely on the generosity of local grocery stores, restaurants, markets, and suppliers to sustain and grow this program.

items.html: ​How You Can Help

​Even with limited resources, we move forward with confidence that our community will rally to make The Community Table thrive. Your support helps keep our shelves stocked and our neighbors nourished.​​​

 

Your financial gift helps us serve daily hot meals and provide grocery boxes to families in need.

  • $50 provides a grocery box for a family of five.

  • $500–$1,000 sustains one full day of hot meal service.

 

​

​​
​​

Are you a restaurant, grocery store, market, or food supplier?
We invite you to join us in providing meals, groceries, and staple goods for our neighbors.
Your contribution — big or small — makes a tangible difference. Please fill out our partner pledge form.
 

 

​

​

We’re building a dedicated team of volunteers to help contact local businesses, pick up donations, pack boxes, prepare meals, and serve food at our distribution site.
Your time, energy, and compassion make all the difference.

​

items.html:
MY Community Cafe in partnership with our partners serve freshly prepared, healthy, vegetarian-friendly meals every week — free for anyone in need, no questions asked. 
 

  • Tuesday – Saturday | 12 PM – 3 PM

  •  3275 Sullivant Avenue, Columbus, OH 43204
     

100–200 meals served daily on a first-come, first-served basis.
Everyone is welcome — individuals, families, and seniors alike.
Each meal is prepared and served with care, turning compassion into action for our neighbors.

The Community Table by MY Project USA
Feeding dignity. Sharing love.

At MY Project USA, we believe no one in our community should go hungry. The Community Table is our new effort to provide free hot meals and essential groceries to families and neighbors in need — one meal, one box, one family at a time. Through the power of community, we are bringing people together to nourish bodies, restore dignity, and share love.

Hot Meals Distribution

Alongside our hot meal program, we are expanding grocery support for families facing food insecurity. This will be in addition to our food distribution at the Mid Ohio Market at MY Project USA.

MY Family Pantry volunteers will be passing additional grocery boxes to those in the highest need, prioritizing families with children and seniors with disabilities. weekly grocery boxes will filled with staple items like rice, flour, lentils, beans, oil, and sugar — enough to feed a family of five for a week.

Distribution will scale up as donations and community contributions increase.

We rely on the generosity of local grocery stores, restaurants, markets, and suppliers to sustain and grow this program.

Your financial gift helps us serve daily hot meals and provide grocery boxes to families in need.

$50 provides a grocery box for a family of five.

$500–$1,000 sustains one full day of hot meal service.
